data.title: 玛修 · 迦勒底走廊
data.description: 【玛修 · 迦勒底走廊】迦勒底明亮的走廊里，玛修抱着一叠文件快步走来，黑裙外搭着灰外套，红领结在灯光下一晃一晃，右眼被粉色刘海遮住却挡不住她的笑容——「前辈，今天的观测报告已经整理好了。」
data.action: 双臂抱稳纸质观测文件快步走来，戴着眼镜向同行者微笑
data.camera: medium-full shot, walking figure and paper reports visible
data.promptProse: Mash walks briskly toward the viewer with paper observation reports held securely in both arms, smiling through glasses beneath the pink-lavender fringe covering her right eye. Black collared dress, open grey jacket, red necktie and dark tights retain her daily outfit. The medium-full view follows futuristic panels down the Chaldea corridor. Ceiling lights catch the stacked page edges and jacket shoulders, with alternating panel shadows reinforcing the corridor's depth.
